req.title: Posts include author username
req.statement: The system shall join post rows with users so index/detail responses include the author's username.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return posts with the author's username included. This involves testing the integration of the posts and users tables in the database and ensuring the correct data is returned in the HTTP response. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_index_includes_author_username_positive
expected: Response contains post with author's username
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' in r.data
assert b'test' in r.data  # username

tests.name: test_index_boundary_case_no_posts
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute('DELETE FROM post')
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'test title' not in r.data
